requirements.quote: Import every eCourts establishment as a forum (code, state, district, establishment) at adapter level A0 from the portal's own option lists, as generated typed seed data under `packages/db/src/seed/forum-catalogue/`
bump FORUM_CATALOGUE_VERSION; keep codes unique and valid; per-state upgrade to A1/A2 is a data flag.
Acceptance: the forum catalogue contains every eCourts establishment, with codes [type:integration].

deliverables.change: Generator that reads state, district and establishment option lists from services.ecourts.gov.in (session and app_token aware) and writes per-state typed seed files plus a manifest of counts. Run manually, not at seed time.

Export ECOURTS_DISTRICT (ForumSeed[]) from generated per-state files (same directory); each row has adapterLevel 'A0', jurisdictionKind 'district', host services.ecourts.gov.in, code in.<state>.<district>.<est-slug>-<est-code>; a per-state level map is the A1/A2 upgrade data flag; skip establishments already hand-listed in chennai-district.ts and bengaluru-district.ts.
Spread ECOURTS_DISTRICT into FORUM_CATALOGUE, bump FORUM_CATALOGUE_VERSION, chunk the upsert insert if the row count would exceed the Postgres parameter limit.

Update the pinned enabled-code list and A1 count to ignore the imported rows; add tests: unique and valid codes, every state present, counts match the manifest, all imported rows A0, seed idempotent with the larger catalogue.
Document the generated ecourts data, how to regenerate it, and the per-state level flag.

preserve.what: Existing hand-written forum codes and rows (Madras HC, Karnataka HC, Chennai and Bengaluru district, tribunals) in packages/db/src/seed/forum-catalogue/*.ts stay unchanged
seedForumCatalogue idempotence, soft-disable and catalogue_meta behaviour (packages/db/src/seed/forum-catalogue/index.ts)

decisions.choice: Generated data is committed as typed seed files; the generator is never run at seed or migrate time
decisions.justification: packages/db/src/seed/forum-catalogue/index.ts:1-9 says the catalogue is typed, versioned seed data re-applied on every deploy; network calls there would break that

decisions.choice: Codes embed the establishment code so they stay unique and valid
decisions.justification: parseForumCatalogue rejects duplicates (index.ts:28-37) and FORUM_CODE_PATTERN (packages/validators/src/forum.ts:24) allows digits and hyphens
